# ZeroTouch Support

> Independent reviews of customer support, business phone and AI voice software. 54 full reviews live here as the canonical version, 25 of them tested hands-on by us (listed below with the date and what we measured); prices are read on the vendor's page and dated. Last updated 2026-11-19.

AIBuilder Marketplace and its sister sites are run by Daniel Haket, a former banker. Every price is read on the vendor's own page and dated; every review says who should skip the tool. Affiliate links never change a verdict. Six sites, one owner.

## Best evidence first: our strongest hands-on reviews
- [CometChat](https://zerotouchsupport.com/cometchat-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-10-23. Best for Product teams adding chat to their app; from $239 · a month at 1,000 MAU billed yearly ($298.75 monthly) · read 2026-10-07; our finding: The pricing cliff is the honest headline: from a 100-MAU free tier straight to ~$239/mo is a brutal jump for an early-stage app, and users report plan structures changing under them.
- [ZenZap](https://zerotouchsupport.com/zenzap-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-10-23. Best for Small teams running work over WhatsApp; from $51 · per month in total for up to 20 users billed yearly ($63 monthly) · read 2026-10-15; our finding: The pricing undercuts Slack: the honest question is integrations: team chat lives or dies on integrations and habit, and ZenZap's app catalog is a fraction of Slack's,…
- [Cloze](https://zerotouchsupport.com/cloze-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-11-16. From $49 · Starter · per month for 250 AI conversations on the App Store listing · read 2026-11-16; not for small stores with a few repeat questions; our finding: On the same day, the App Store listing sold this at $49, $99 and $199 a month for 250, 750 and 2,000 conversations.
- [Zendesk](https://zerotouchsupport.com/zendesk-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-11-13. Best for Multi-department support teams past a shared inbox; from $19 · per agent a month, annual billing (US storefront) · read 2026-10-07; our finding: The prices shown are annual-billed: month-to-month costs more: €25, €69 and €149 per agent against €19, €55 and €115, read from the Netherlands on 7 October 2026.
- [Quo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/quo-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-11-19. From $15 · Starter · per user per month billed annually · read 2026-11-18; not for teams on the road or past ten users; our finding: Call reliability is the recurring complaint: G2 logs hundreds of connection and disconnection reports, and calls get shaky the moment you're off Wi-Fi.
- [Intercom](https://zerotouchsupport.com/intercom-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-11-18. Best for Small support teams that want one inbox with an AI agent; from $29 · Essential · per seat per month · read 2026-11-17; our finding: The bill has two meters: a price per seat and $0.99 for each conversation Fin resolves, so it grows with both team size and volume.
- [Vanity Number](https://zerotouchsupport.com/vanity-number-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-11-18. Best for US and Canadian businesses wanting a memorable number for ads; from $99.99 · cheapest number · one-time search and acquisition fee per number, rising with how · read 2026-10-11; not for businesses that need the phone service itself; our finding: Refunds are not possible, and not every carrier accepts every number,…
- [AskNest](https://zerotouchsupport.com/asknest-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-11-17. From $4.99 · Starter · per month for 500 AI replies with automatic shopper-language detection · read 2026-10-09; not for stores needing human handover or tickets; our finding: The app launched on 8 May 2026, and in three and a half months exactly one merchant has written about it.
- [Gorgias](https://zerotouchsupport.com/gorgias-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-11-17. Best for Ecommerce support teams with seasonal volume spikes; from $40 · Starter · per month with the AI Agent included, monthly billing · read 2026-11-17; not for small shops with a few dozen tickets monthly; our finding: Never priced per agent is a real advantage, but it starts one tier up: the comparison table caps…
- [HelpCenter](https://zerotouchsupport.com/helpcenter-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-11-17. Best for Small Shopify stores with growing support volume; from $40 · Standard · per month, or $400 a year · read 2026-11-12; not for support teams serving a company beyond one store; our finding: The free tier is the hook and the FAQ builder is the reason people stay.

## Tested hands-on (25): first-hand findings
We signed up and ran these tools ourselves. The date is the test date; the line is what we measured, not the vendor's claim. All other reviews are researched from the vendor's own pages and buyer reviews, and say so on the page.
- [Quo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/quo-review.html): tested 2026-11-19. Measured 2026-11-19: Billing shows Credits remaining 1,000 / 1,000 with overages disabled at $1 per call; the dossier says every plan includes 1,000 automation credits a month.
- [Intercom](https://zerotouchsupport.com/intercom-review.html): tested 2026-11-18. Measured 2026-11-18: Asked Do you sell snowboard helmets?, Fin said the store does not carry helmets, with Content (4) as its source, although none of the articles says that. It should have said that it did not know.
- [Vanity Number](https://zerotouchsupport.com/vanity-number-review.html): tested 2026-11-18. Measured 2026-11-18: Text we checked: "(603) DENTIST, Hinsdale, New Hampshire, $3,000.00". ## Reviews (54) — canonical versions
- [800.com Review (2026): From $19/mo, Checked Oct 2026](https://zerotouchsupport.com/800-com-review.html): 800.com: Startup $19/mo and Small Business $49/mo. The 250-minute cap on Startup (it was 1,000 in August) matters for any real call volume.
- [Aircall Review (2026): From $30/mo, Checked Oct 2026](https://zerotouchsupport.com/aircall-review.html): Aircall: Essentials is $30 per license a month and Professional $50, both on annual billing. 'Unlimited calling' covers listed regions, check yours.
- [Answering Service Care Review (2026): Price & Limits](https://zerotouchsupport.com/answering-service-care-review.html): Answering Service Care: $161, $296 and $575 for the three larger plans. Do the arithmetic before you pick a tier, because their own page does not.
- [AskNest Review (Tested): 50 Free AI Replies, Then $4.99/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/asknest-review.html) (tested hands-on): AskNest: All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days, and no paid tier shows a free trial, the free plan is the trial.
- [bOnline Review (2026): UK Business VoIP From £7 a User](https://zerotouchsupport.com/bonline-review.html): bOnline: AI For Business Calls is £19.95, shown against a struck-through £21.95. BOnline does not put its contract length on the pricing page.
- [Calilio Review (2026): $12 a Seat, Calls Meter Apart](https://zerotouchsupport.com/calilio-review.html): Calilio: Standard $15 per user/mo, or $12 billed annually ($144 a year). The subscription is the platform, not the talking.
- [CallHippo Review (2026): Part Published, Part on Quote](https://zerotouchsupport.com/callhippo-review.html): CallHippo: Read the tab before the number. 'Unlimited calling' is unlimited to the US and Canada: international minutes meter separately.

- [CometChat Review (Tested): Free to 100 Users, Then $239/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/cometchat-review.html) (tested hands-on): CometChat, Billed yearly, shown as a monthly equivalent: at 1,000 MAU Basic is $239 and Advanced $359. The pricing cliff is the honest headline.
- [CrankWheel Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $29/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/crankwheel-review.html): CrankWheel: A free plan with no payment details required. If you want an all-purpose meeting platform, this isn't it.

## Machine-readable
- [For AI agents](https://aibuildermarketplace.com/agents/): a read-only JSON API covering the reviews on this site too. https://aibuildermarketplace.com/api/v1/index.json lists every product; each record links its canonical review here, plan prices where structured, cost traps with full evidence, the pricing date and what is unknown. No key needed. Remote MCP server (read-only, no key): https://api.aibuildermarketplace.com/mcp, with tools such as search_products, get_product, compare_products, get_evidence, estimate_cost and check_choice; the same data as HTTP/JSON under https://api.aibuildermarketplace.com/v1/.
- [Full review catalog with prices (plain text)](https://zerotouchsupport.com/llms-full.txt)
- [Structured JSON](https://zerotouchsupport.com/data.json): tools in this niche as JSON
- Network: [AIBuilder Marketplace](https://aibuildermarketplace.com) holds the wider catalog (https://aibuildermarketplace.com/llms.txt); this site is the canonical home for the reviews listed above.
